label: Midday Update
headline: S&P 500 +1.3% at 11:34, Nasdaq +1.8%, VIX down to 25.4; 10y yield +7bp to 4.92%
stance: Stocks rose less than the 5am futures but sit at the day's highs into the 1:00 close. Treasury yields are higher.
bullets: S&P 500 fell to 7,182 just after the open, then climbed to 7,266 by 10:56 and 7,277 at 11:34.
10y Treasury yield 4.92% at 11:19, up 7bp from Wednesday's close.
October goods trade gap $149.5bn vs $133.0bn expected (8:30). A wider gap lowers fourth-quarter GDP estimates.
Iran's Revolutionary Guard navy commander said breaking the US naval blockade is imminent (10:13). Brent -0.3% at 11:24.

items.head: Micron +7% pre-market
items.body: Chip stocks rebounded after this month's selloff (9:01).

items.head: Sandisk up nearly 11%
items.body: Gain in Friday trading as memory and chip stocks recovered (10:29).

watch.head: NYSE closes early, 1:00
watch.body: Shortened session after Thanksgiving. Dow up about 540 points at 11:34.

watch.head: Iran naval blockade headlines
watch.body: Brent $94.30 at 11:24, little changed on the Iran comments.
